descriptions.zh:
先通过[CreateMixStream接口](~~2848087~~)创建合流任务，再调用本接口删除合流任务。当您不需要使用某条合流后，请删除此条合流，否则合流将一直处于输出状态。


## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Before you call this operation, you must create a stream mixing task by calling the [CreateMixStream](~~2848087~~) operation. If you no longer need the mixed stream, you must delete the task. Otherwise, the stream will be continuously ingested.

## QPS limits

The queries per second (QPS) limit for this operation is 10 for each user. API calls that exceed this limit are throttled, which may affect your business. Plan your calls accordingly.
